backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing invoice and payment management with role-based access control, including invoice upload, payment processing (single and batch), user profile management, and payment history tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report placeholder with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks describing authentication, payment entry, batch payments, reports, admin features, and UI components with their specific functionality and bug fixes.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Production deployment checklist covering authentication, admin/user features, UI/UX verification, data integrity checks, browser compatibility, known limitations about admin identity assignment, and post-deployment smoke tests.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router setup, route definitions for admin/user pages, authentication guards, role-based navigation, and loading states for all protected routes.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Access denied screen component displaying a message that admin permissions are required and must be granted by an administrator, with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new user profile setup that saves profiles with default 'user' role and displays guidance that admin access is assigned by administrators, not self-selected.
Displays a dismissible alert prompting users to complete their profile setup, with a button that opens the ProfileSetupModal.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component that provides navigation, header with user info, logout functionality, and conditionally displays the ProfileSetupPrompt for users without profiles. Includes responsive mobile menu and role-based navigation items.
frontend/src/components/payments/BatchPa: Form component for batch payment entry that displays selected invoices grouped by retailer, payment mode selection (cheque/online), and collects payment details including amount, transaction ID, bank name, cheque number, and payment date.
frontend/src/components/payments/Invoice: Searchable invoice selection component that allows users to search and select multiple invoices across retailers by invoice number, retailer code, or name, displaying selected invoices grouped by retailer with total amounts.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Dynamic form editor for managing multiple payment lines with different modes (cash, cheque, online transfer), allowing users to add/remove payment entries and input mode-specific details like cheque numbers or transaction IDs.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Filter component for reports that provides date range, salesman, payment type, and payment mode filters, extracting unique salesmen from invoice data and converting date inputs to bigint timestamps.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays a grouped table of payment entries by retailer, expanding each payment to show individual invoice rows with payment details (date, mode, transaction ID, bank info). Includes currency formatting and payment type/mode badge rendering.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: Renders a paginated, sortable table of invoices with columns for retailer info, invoice details, amounts, status badges, and ageing days. Includes navigation to invoice details, payment history, and batch payment entry.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Custom hook that fetches the current user's profile and role from the backend actor, returning loading states and an isAdmin flag based on the effective role.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient creation with configurable options including derivation origin.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching invoices, payments, and payment history, plus mutations for uploading invoices, clearing data, and adding/batch-adding payments with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors (background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, destructive, borders, charts) using oklch color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped in QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying financial statistics (total outstanding, collection, excess, pending balance) with loading states, error handling, and retry functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Invoice management page for admins to upload invoice data from Excel files, download templates, clear all data, and view/filter invoices in a table with search capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: User management page for admins to view all system users and assign roles (admin/user) with confirmation dialogs and visual role indicators.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication with error handling, retry logic for duplicate sessions, and displays welcome information including admin access requirements.
frontend/src/pages/payments/BatchPayment: Batch payment entry page allowing users to select multiple invoices across retailers and record a single payment with cheque or online payment details.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Payment editing page that loads existing payment details and allows modification of amount, payment mode, and mode-specific fields (transaction ID, cheque details) with validation.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Payment entry form page that allows users to record payments against invoices with multiple payment modes (cash, cheque, bank transfer), validates entries, calculates totals and excess payments, and submits payment records to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a paginated table of all payment history for a specific retailer, showing payment dates, modes, amounts, references, and admin-only edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Reports dashboard page with filters for date range, salesman, payment type/mode, displaying summary statistics (total collected, excess, pending) and a retailer-wise ledger table with CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: TypeScript interface defining the PaymentLine structure with fields for payment mode (cash/cheque/online) and mode-specific details like amounts, bank names, cheque numbers, and transaction IDs.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses CSV/XLSX invoice upload files, validates required columns (Retailer Code, Name, Invoice Number, Date, Salesman, Balance Amount), and converts rows into Invoice objects with optional Ageing Days column support.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Exports payment reports to CSV format with summary statistics and detailed payment rows, expanding each payment by invoice and including mode-specific fields (cheque details, RTGS/NEFT details) with retailer and salesman information.
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Generates and downloads a CSV template file with headers for invoice uploads, including required columns and an optional Ageing Days column positioned after Invoice Date.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides invoice filtering logic based on retailer name, retailer code, invoice number, and salesman name with case-insensitive matching.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Provides functions to parse invoice date strings in various formats, calculate ageing days from invoice date to today, and format the result for display.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes invoice status from multiple formats (string enum, variant object, or unknown) into a canonical string key ('unpaid', 'partiallyPaid', 'paid', 'excess').
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentDates: Derives effective payment date from PaymentEntry based on payment mode (bank transfer, cheque, or fallback) and provides conversion utilities between HTML date inputs and backend nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Calculates payment totals from multiple payment lines, determines remaining or excess amounts, and returns payment status ('Fully Paid', 'Partially Paid', 'Excess Payment').
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from the URL.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entry forms by checking payment type, ensuring at least one valid payment line with positive amount, and verifying required fields for cheque and online transfer modes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, container settings, extended utilities (shadows, animations), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural notes, known issues, and feature requests including AR-2 to modify Excel export to generate one row per invoice with duplicated payment details when a payment covers multiple invoices.
